name: Grain Boundary Length Measurement in Metallographic Sample
description:
You are a materials scientist characterizing an Au-Pb-Sn solder alloy. Open the built-in 'AuPbSn 40' sample in Fiji (File > Open Samples > AuPbSn 40). Select a single representative slice from this stack (e.g., duplicate the middle slice). Your goal is to measure the total length of the inter-phase boundaries.

Perform the following workflow:
1. Preprocess the image to reduce noise (e.g., Gaussian blur).
2. Detect phase boundaries (using Edge Detection or Thresholding).
3. Create a binary skeleton of the boundaries (Process > Binary > Skeletonize).
4. Measure the total length of the boundary network (count foreground pixels in the skeleton).
5. Calculate the Boundary Density (Total Boundary Length / Total Image Area).

Save a CSV file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/grain_boundary_analysis.csv' containing:
- Image dimensions (width, height)
- Total image area (pixels^2)
- Total boundary length (pixels)
- Boundary density (pixels^-1)
